behavior: Recovery controls appear only after file/account/target validation and an empty read-only preflight.
Fresh phrase and explicit checkbox approval are required; the encrypted verified envelope and approval are consumed after each attempt.
Vault revalidates and checks any-row occupancy inside one atomic add-only IndexedDB transaction.
Successful recovery stays locked; the candidate initialization panel updates to prevent offering a new empty fixture over recovered data.
Owner must unlock deliberately, inspect recovered records and export/verify a new bundle.
UI round trip preserves original unsaved resolution draft, reviewed snapshot revision history and operation receipts.
Wrong phrase, occupied-after-preflight, native quota failure, lock and logout interruption do not overwrite or automatically retry.
Ambiguous failures ask for inspection; they do not falsely promise that no commit could have occurred.
remainingBlockers: Original normal-backup crypto APIs remain intact, but these controls accept portable bundles only; complete legacy-format dispatch/acceptance in the guarded recovery UI before calling the whole recovery workflow complete.
Deliberate resolution-save UI remains disabled pending the remaining compatibility and integrated workflow review.
Native Safari, installed-app and deployed acceptance remain unverified; Gate 4 resource UUID/routing/source-evidence blockers remain open.
nextPriority: Finish backward-compatible original-format verification/recovery dispatch through the same guarded candidate UI, then review explicit resolution-save activation.
